name: "Zeroth Style Gale, Azure Skies" Mayuzumi Fubuki "Re:B"

en.plain:
[Call Cost] [Pay 2 gauge]
If this card has two or less soul, it gets [Weaponry Link].
When a 《Weaponry》 is put into this card's soul, you gain 1 life and draw 1 card.
For each card in this card's soul, all 《Mobile Aerial Team》 on your field get power+3000 and defense+3000.
